title: Fees, jobs and wallet bridge: six legacy lib files moved to finance/fees, finance/jobs, finance/integrations; F23 to F26
statusReason: Code moved, static and pure checks pass, but the WP-7 DB tests were written and NOT run: the package registry was unreachable in this session (403 from the egress proxy), so pnpm install, tsx, tsc and the DB suite could not run. Also no commit SHA, no Replit checkout run, no staging walk-through.

commit.workingTree: Uncommitted; cumulative with WP-2b to WP-6b; bound by content in fin-provenance-manifest.json.

oldToNew.ledger/journal.ts: added postEntryJournalInTx, postLateFeeAccrualJournalInTx (postEntryJournal and postLateFeeAccrualJournal keep their behavior)

findings.F23: late-fee accrual: conditional, one transaction with its journal; unpostable journal rolls back; sub-cent overdue flip conditional
findings.F24: due-date reminder: claim first, release on failure, per-entry isolation, due-date-changed guard
findings.F25: overdue invoice nudge: claim first, restore when nothing delivered
findings.F26: wallet bridge: entry and journal in one transaction

behaviorChanges: Two overlapping late-fee sweeps charge a period once; a settled entry is not charged; a failed journal means no accrual (retried next sweep) instead of an entry with no journal.
Reminder and invoice-nudge sweeps no longer double-send under overlap; a throwing entry no longer aborts the reminder sweep.
A wallet deposit or withdrawal whose journal cannot be posted is not recorded at all (before: recorded without a journal and never repaired).
Late fees are rounded to cents.
New one-off repair for old wallet entries without a journal.
